The team has monitored the same plots since 2021 and ______ measurements every month. Its long record now makes gradual changes easier to distinguish from short-term fluctuations.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanationMd: The period begins in the past and continues to the present. Present perfect has recorded parallels has monitored and agrees with the singular subject team.

distractorRationale.d: The plural-form present verb does not agree with the singular collective subject team in this sentence.
distractorRationale.a: The future-perfect tense does not match the ongoing period beginning in 2021.
distractorRationale.b: Past perfect would place the recording before a separate past reference point not given here.
